title: How a Godly Man Kills the Laziness He's Started Calling Rest
caption:
Not every rest is holy rest. Some of it's just the laziness you've learned to defend.

Four ways to tell the difference:

Name what you're actually avoiding. Check what it costs you after. Put a clock on it before you start. Do one hard thing first.

A little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to rest, and poverty comes like a robber (Proverbs 6:10-11). It's not about the nap. It's about what the nap is hiding from.

Rest is what you earn. Laziness is what you excuse.
